title: A-share 120D Decision Targets
subtitle: Future 10-day event labels paired to the temporal-symbol-holdout panels
description: Compact decision-label sidecar for the A-share 120D Temporal Symbol Holdout dataset. Contains no OHLCVA panel data. Join labels to panel windows using symbol, start_index, and asof_date. Training signals end on 2024-12-31; validation signals cover 2025-07-01 through 2026-07-02. The manifest records source panel SHA-256 values and the 120+10+1 window contract.
